structs.name: DBFileHandle

The IDA DBFile type (136 bytes, name[64] at 0, dbFileHandle[16] at 64, isSecured at 80) is consistent with 16 but its isSecured offset is not Replay-proven: no access to +50h in DB_AsyncIWFileLoad_ReadHeader, BatchRead, Shutdown, Update, DirtyDiscError, VerifyChunkHash, PumpDecodeQueue, WaitForAsyncCompletion or CopyChainState. Upper bound: none proven from Replay (72 is refuted only if isSecured is at +80). Best estimate 16 (game-test size 16 agrees).

structs.name: DemonwareFence
structs.size_evidence: NOT PROVEN. Lower bound 80: DemonwareFence derives from FenceObject. Its vtable slots at 0x1423EC400 are DemonwareFence::UpdateIsPassingInternal, then FenceObject::UpdateDependencies (0x140F19C70) and FenceObject_GetFenceValue (0x140F19C50), the FenceObject virtuals. FenceObject is 80 bytes (IDA type, game-test). Evidence for 80 as the FenceObject size: the static fence globals in FenceObjects_Init@0x140F1A600 and their dynamic initializers (dynamic_initializer_for_qword_14B4ABA80, ..._14B4AC170, Online_StaticObj_Init@0x14033E2A0) are placed at exact 0x50 spacing (stru_14B4ABA80, ..ABAD0, ..ABB20, ..ABB70, ..ABBC0, ..ABC10, ..ABC60, ..ABCB0, ..ABD00, ..ABD50, ..ABDA0, ..ABDF0, ..ABE40, ..ABE90, ..ABEE0, ..ABF30, ..ABF80, ..ABFD0, ..AC020, ..AC070), and they write FenceObject fields up to +72. Upper bound: none proven for DemonwareFence itself. No Replay instance construction of DemonwareFence was found (no xref to its vtable at 0x1423EC400 from code), and no own member beyond +14 is used by Replay. The IDA 120 has no Replay evidence (its members at 64 and above are inside the FenceObject base).

structs.name: DiskFile
structs.size_evidence: method 4 (array stride) + method 1 shape: DiskFS_OpenFileHandle@0x140F62C40 walks the open-file slots at diskFs+8 with `v9 += 312` for up to 256 slots (Sys_Error "DiskFS: Out of file handles" at 256); each slot is the DiskFile returned as the open file, and it is written at +256 (dword 1), +264 (qword handle, free sentinel -1 tested in the loop), +304 (dword flags), and Core_strcopy(v9, 256, path) fills the name. These are the same offsets DiskFile::DiskFile@0x140F633B0 (stores -1 at +264, 0 at +256, 0 at +304), DiskFile::StartRead, DiskFile_Wait, DiskFile_Close, DiskFile_GetFileSize and DiskFS_ReadBlocking use, so the slot element is DiskFile. Max Replay access end is 308 (dword flags at 304), stride 312. Game-test fields m_lastReadEndOffset (256, qword) and m_lastStartReadTime (264, qword) have no Replay evidence: Replay has a 4-byte state at 256 and the handle at 264. IDA's size 2400 is not supported.
